column1: # PEPC (phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase, ppc-1E1c / "ppc") C4-associated sites — Tier 1
# Phenotype: C3 vs C4 photosynthesis in Cyperaceae (sedges). Fixture =
# validation/fixtures/tier1/pepc/ (79 tips, 23 "genotypic" C4 by the A780S
# determinant, from Besnard et al. 2009 via the PCOC / ConDor test data).
# Numbering: maize C4 PEPC1 (UniProt P04711, 970 aa). The fixture alignment is
# projected onto maize coordinates and is exactly 970 columns, so
#   ref position N  ==  alignment column N   (1:1, no ref row needed).
# Evidence tiers (column `tier`):
#   mutagenesis  : residue change functionally demonstrated (kinetics / folding)
#   selection    : Besnard 2009 BEB positive selection on C4 branches AND
#                  recovered by >=1 reanalysis (PCOC / ConDor / FADE, Morel 2024)
#   parallel     : Besnard 2009 positive-selection site with a parallel change
#                  also reported in grass / eudicot C4 PEPC (cross-family)
#   weak         : Besnard 2009 candidate, <3 independent emergences in the
#                  ConDor reanalysis, not otherwise confirmed
# Sources: Blasing2000 (780 kinetics); Paulus2013 / Engelmann2002 (665 folding/
#   activity); Besnard2009 (MBE 26:1909, 16 positive-selection codons);
#   Christin2007 (Curr Biol, grass PEPC parallel codons); Morel2024 (ConDor,
#   GBE, doi:10.1093/gbe/evae040 — 5 TP: M749T P540T E572Q A780S H665N).
